verdict.rationale: Stable's marketing describes keyword-based auto-routing of incoming mail to teams, which is a rule that fires an action when new mail arrives. It also describes configurable Slack/email alerts on new mail and automated check deposits. These are narrow, mail-specific automations. Webhooks are only an event-delivery building block, not user-defined rules, and no general rule engine is documented. missing for 10: documented rule builder (conditions/actions configuration), rule types beyond routing and alerts, in-depth docs for how rules are defined, independent or hands-on corroboration.
